title: She Got Drunk and Drove Around a Private Airport: Cops
description:
A woman was arrested after allegedly drunk driving around a small airport in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Police took Bonnie Campbell, 53, into custody after Air Traffic Control allegedly reported someone driving around the tarmac and blocking the path of planes. Officers can be heard on body camera telling Campbell this incident was the third time officers have made contact with her over similar concerns. The stumbling, mumbling 53-year-old refused field sobriety tests before she was cuffed and taken to the police station. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
